$doc: Kitty Vs Everything — asset manifest for tools/import-assets.mjs. Maps canonical asset KEYS to PNG file names inside the shared art folder (Z:\Dev\AI-GAMES\.assets). Add a line here and re-run `node tools/import-assets.mjs` to import new art — no game code changes needed for the registry. Resolution order per key: (1) exact file name, (2) normalized fuzzy match (lowercase, spaces/-/_ stripped) against the folder listing, (3) hard error listing the available PNGs. The importer validates each PNG (signature, IHDR, 8-bit RGBA, non-transparent content), normalizes art larger than 128px (box-filter downscale + re-encode) and generates 'Kitty Vs Everything/js/core/AssetSprites.js' (embedded base64 + dimensions).
